title: Medium Transport
caption: Medium Transport (V)
game_text: Permanent pilot provides no ability. During battle, may target an opponent’s capital starship present. Draw destiny. Target and this starship are lost if destiny + 2 > target’s defense value.
lore: Passenger and cargo transport built by Gallofree Yards. Enormous cargo bays can be outfitted to safely accommodate large numbers of troops, munitions or supplies.

notes: Non-unique (no dot on slip or printed card). Banner CAPITAL: TRANSPORT. Stats POWER 0 / ARMOR 3 / HYPERSPEED 4 (the ARMOR value sits right-aligned in its box on the slip); deploy 4 / forfeit 1. Scomp-link ring → scomp true. Icon column top to bottom: yellow pilot helmet (permanent pilot) → permanent-pilot, nav (red square, green dome). Curly apostrophes in opponent’s / target’s. Lore matches the scan. Base scan only at 350 px; copyright 1996 (Hoth). No modern PC remake or Virtual Block image found on the wiki (modern null).
